tīra: Tīra (nt.) [Vedic tiras from *ter, tarati; orig. the opposite bank, the farther side (of a river or ocean), cp. tittha] 기슭, 둔덕 Vin I.1; D I.222, 244; A II.29, 50; Dh 85; Sn 672; J I.212, 222, 279; II.111, 159; Dhs 597; Vbh 71 sq.; Vism 512 (orima°); PvA 142, 152. -- tīra--dassin 기슭을 찾은 S III.164; A III.368. -- a--tīra--dassanī (f.) 기슭을 보지 못한 (nāvā 배) J V.75.
tīraṇa: Tīraṇa [from tīreti 2] 재량, 판단, 인지 Nd2 413 (v. l. tir°); Nett 54 (+vipassanā), 82 (?€nāṇa), 191; Vism 162. -- tīraṇa 는 세 parinnā 들중의 하나, viz. t°, pahāna°, nāta--parinnā. See under parinnā.
tīreti: Tīreti [Caus. of tarati] 1. 이겨내게 하다, 끝내다, (일을) 실행하다, 성취하다: karaṇīyaṁ Miln 7, PvA 203; kiccaṁ PvA 278. -- 2. 재다, 판단하다, 인지하다, 항상 정형구에서 tūleti tīreti vibhāveti (Nd2 tul° tir°, etc.) as interpretation of jānāti; pp. tīrita (Nd2 tirita) Ps II.200; Nd2 under nāta & No. 413.
tīvarā: Tīvarā (pl.) Buddha Kakusandha 시대의 사람 이름 S II.191.
tīhaṃ: Tīhaṁ (adv.) [tri+aha] 사흘의 기간, 3일 동안; usually as cpd. dvīhatīhaṁ 2 or 3 days (see dvīha) J II.103, etc.
